episodes.overview: While Rudeus reunites with his father in Millishion, Eris sets out to fulfill her dream of slaying goblins. While at the Adventurers' Guild, however, she encounters Cliff, a conceited young mage who threatens to spoil her adventure.
episodes.title: Eris the Goblin Slayer

episodes.overview: The mass-teleportation in Fittoa places Princess Ariel Anemoi Asura in mortal peril—then drops a powerful new bodyguard into her lap! While Rudeus and Eris journeyed home, a deadly drama was playing out in the halls of power.
episodes.title: Guardian Fitz

episodes.overview: The main cast members, Yumi Uchiyama as Rudeus, Ai Kayano as Sylphiette, Saya Aizawa as Norn, Yuuki Takada as Aisha, and Yoshimi Kohara as Roxy, will appear. While interweaving precious interviews with the cast and footage from the anime, the story of the "Newlywed Arc" that has unfolded so far in the second season will be played back, and the outlook and highlights of the "Teleportation Labyrinth Arc" will be explored.
episodes.title: Mushoku Tensei II ~I'll be serious when I go to another world~ [Transfer Labyrinth Edition] Last Minute Special

episodes.overview: The main cast members, Yumi Uchiyama as Rudeus, Ai Kayano as Sylphiette, Saya Aizawa as Norn, Yuuki Takada as Aisha, and Yoshimi Kohara as Roxy, will appear. While interweaving precious interviews with the cast and footage from the anime, we will play back the story of the "Newlywed Arc" that has unfolded so far in the second season, and look ahead to the prospects and highlights of the "Transfer Labyrinth Arc".
episodes.title: Mushoku Tensei II: Jobless Reincarnation II ~I Will Seriously Try If I Go to Another World~ Special Program

episodes.overview: A 34-year-old unemployed recluse get hit by a truck... and wakes up as a newborn baby in a fantasy world! With loving parents, a lifetime of regrets, and a beginner's magic textbook, he sets out to make the most of his second chance at life.
episodes.title: Jobless Reincarnation

episodes.overview: Rudy begins training with his new magic tutor and learning swordsmanship from his father. He makes rapid progress, but traumatic memories from his past life leave him to afraid to go outside. Is his second chance already doomed to failure?
episodes.title: Master

episodes.overview: Rudy begins to explore the village and rescues a green-haired child from a group of bullies. The two grow close practicing magic, but is there more to Rudy's new friend than he thinks?
episodes.title: A Friend

episodes.overview: The Greyrat family is overjoyed when Zenith announces that she's pregnant with a second child, but the mood takes a dour turn when Lilia reveals that she is also pregnant and Paul is the father. Will this be the end of Rudy's happy family?
episodes.title: Emergency Family Meeting

episodes.overview: Rudy arrives in the city of Roa, where he's supposed to spend the next five years tutoring the daughter of the local lord. His student, however, is more than he bargained for, and he'll have to fight to start his first ever job, let alone keep it.
episodes.title: A Young Lady and Violence

episodes.overview: Rudy is officially Eris's tutor, but she doesn't want to learn anything but magic. As Rudy struggles to get her interested in other subjects, he realizes that non-stop lessons are causing her stress and proposes a day off in the city.
episodes.title: A Day Off in Roa

episodes.overview: Eris's 10th birthday is fast approaching, and her grandfather has invited nobles from across the kingdom to a dance party to celebrate. There's just one problem: Eris can't dance, and she's quickly losing patience with her lessons.
episodes.title: What Lies Beyond Effort

episodes.overview: Rudy reaches his 10th birthday, and Eris and her family plan a surprise party for him. Meanwhile, the strange orb hovering over the city remains a mystery as powerful entities across the world begin to take note of it.
episodes.title: Turning Point 1

episodes.overview: Rudy and Eris find themselves stranded in the wilds of the Demon Continent. Their only chance to survive seems to lie in Ruijerd, a warrior of the infamous Superd tribe of demons, but can he be trusted?
episodes.title: A Chance Encounter

episodes.overview: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd make it to a city. They need to earn money for their journey, and decide to register as adventurers, but Superd like Ruijerd aren't allowed inside. Rudeus has a plan, but how well will it hold up in practice?
episodes.title: The Value of a Life and the First Job

episodes.overview: With their new money-making scheme in place, Dead End head out to track down a mysterious monster. Unfortunately, the job doesn't go as smoothly as they hope, and Rudy's plans may turn out to be a lot less safe than he thought.
episodes.title: Children and Warriors

episodes.overview: Dead End discovers that Ruijerd will have to pay a fortune in fees to leave the Demon Continent. As they struggle to find a way around this unexpected roadblock, Rudeus receives another vision.
episodes.title: The Woman with the Demon Eyes

episodes.overview: Roxy arrives on the Demon Continent to begin her search for Paul's missing family. Meanwhile, Rudeus strikes a deal with smugglers to transport Ruijerd across the ocean.
episodes.title: Missed Connections

episodes.overview: Rudeus finds himself imprisoned by the beast people in Doldia Village. Will Ruijerd and Eris arrive to clear his name before he loses patience and tries to fight his way to freedom?
episodes.title: No Such Thing As a Free Lunch

episodes.overview: Dead End decide to wait out the rainy season in the Doldia village. Eris befriends the chieftain's granddaughter, but her fondness for Ghislaine leads to unexpected conflict.
episodes.title: Slow Life in the Doldia Village

episodes.overview: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd arrive in the Holy Country of Millis, where Rudeus's thoughts turn to home. When the three split up for a day off, a chance encounter in an alley leads Rudeus to a shocking reunion.
episodes.title: Family Squabble

episodes.overview: In the aftermath of their disastrous reunion, Paul and Rudeus reflect on their actions and look for a way forward.
episodes.title: Reunion

episodes.overview: After setting out from Millishion, Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd board a ship back to the Central Continent. Meanwhile, Roxy arrives in Rikarisu, where she encounters some familiar faces.
episodes.title: Separate Journeys

episodes.overview: Dead End finally arrives in the Shirone Kingdom on the Central Continent. Rudeus is anxious for a reunion with Roxy, but an unexpected vision from the Man-God means he may be in for more than he bargained for.
episodes.title: Route Selection

episodes.overview: Rudeus is in desperate straits, imprisoned in a magic-proof dungeon by a despotic prince. But just when all seems hopeless, an unexpected visitor appears with a strange request. Will Rudeus be able to talk his way out of this one?
episodes.title: The Birth of My Little Sister, the Maid

episodes.overview: Rudeus, Eris, and Ruijerd are nearing the end of their journey, but a chance encounter in a snowy mountain pass threatens to put a premature end to their adventures.
episodes.title: Turning Point 2

episodes.overview: Rudeus and Eris finally return to Fittoa, but sudden goodbyes and unpleasant news make their homecoming bittersweet.
episodes.title: Dreams and Reality

episodes.overview: Rudeus sinks into depression following Eris's departure. As he struggles to get back on his feet, the many people he's met continue their own journeys.
episodes.title: Wake Up and Take a Step

episodes.overview: Rudeus journeys to the harsh northlands in search of his lost mother. Or at least, that's what he tells himself. The scars of his parting from Eris run deep, and getting back on his feet may not be so easy.
episodes.title: The Brokenhearted Mage

episodes.overview: Rudeus doesn't want a new party, but he still grows closer Counter Arrow as he settles into life as a northlands adventurer. When danger rears its head, he finds himself risking it all for his new friends.
episodes.title: The Forest in the Dead of Night

episodes.overview: Things seem to be looking up for Rudeus. And when Sara asks him on a date, he decides to forget his heartbreak and start a new romance. But putting the past behind him may be easier said than done.
episodes.title: Abrupt Approach

episodes.overview: After two years of adventuring with Soldat, Rudeus is no closer to finding his mother or curing his impotence. But the sudden arrival of a seductive elf and an unexpected offer could send his life off in a whole new direction.
episodes.title: Letter of Invitation

episodes.overview: Following the Man-God's advice, Rudeus enrolls in school. He reunites with an old friend and meets potential new enemies, but will he find what he seeks? And what does the future hold for him and the enigmatic "Silent Fitz"?
episodes.title: Ranoa University of Magic

episodes.overview: Rudeus is settling into school life and growing better acquainted with the enigmatic Silent Fitz. But when his efforts to teach Zanoba hit a roadblock, his new friend proposes a drastic solution.
episodes.title: I Don't Want To Die

episodes.overview: When Rudeus discovers that two of his new schoolmates have destroyed one of his precious figures, he swears revenge. But while he may be able to trounce schoolgirls in a fight, figuring out what to do with them next won't be so easy.
episodes.title: The Kidnapping and Confinement of Beast Girls

episodes.overview: Love is in the air. First, a smitten classmate seeks Rudeus's help to meet the girl of his dreams. Then the beast people's mating season puts Rudeus in an awkward position—one he'll have to fight his way out of.
episodes.title: The Fiancé of Despair

episodes.overview: Investigating the mass teleportation leads Rudeus to seek out his most elusive classmate: the brilliant Silent Sevenstar. But when he calls at Silent's laboratory tower, he finds a familiar face that he didn't expect—and doesn't welcome.
episodes.title: The White Mask

episodes.overview: Rudeus settles into a new routine at the university. But as time passes, Silent Fitz is increasingly in his thoughts. What does he really feel for his enigmatic classmate? And how far will he pry into a friend's secrets to find out?
episodes.title: These Feelings

episodes.overview: Ariel confronts Sylphiette with a choice: reveal herself to Rudeus or cut ties with him forever. Determined on one last push to jog Rudeus's memory, Sylphiette invites him on a forest expedition.
episodes.title: To You

episodes.overview: Sylphiette reveals herself and Rudeus admits his feelings, but even that isn't enough to cure what ails him. After their heart-to-heart, Sylphiette sets out to end his problem once and for all.
episodes.title: I Want to Tell You

episodes.overview: Newly cured and brimming with confidence, Rudeus resolves to marry Sylphie. Just one problem: he has no idea how marriage works in this world. And when friends tell him any newlywed needs a house, he winds up with a haunted mansion.
episodes.title: My Dream Home

episodes.overview: The newlyweds have settled into their new home. Next, custom dictates they throw a party for everyone they know. Preparing to host a crowd won't be easy. And even if they pull it off, the big day has surprises in store.
episodes.title: Wedding Reception

episodes.overview: Rudeus receives a letter from Paul. The letter explains that Norn and Aisha, Rudeus's younger sisters, have been sent to join Rudeus. Meanwhile Nanahoshi continues her research into summoning magic for a way to return to her original world.
episodes.title: Afar

episodes.overview: Rudeus's sisters arrive with an unexpected chaperone. After catching up with an old friend, Rudeus decides it's time to send the girls to school. But convincing Norn and Aisha turns out to be more trouble than he bargained for.
episodes.title: Norn and Aisha

episodes.overview: Norn shuts herself in her dorm room and refuses to attend classes. Haunted by the specter of his past life, Rudeus sets out to solve his sister's problems, only to discover that he is the cause.
episodes.title: My Older Brother's Feelings

episodes.overview: Life is looking up for Rudeus. His sisters are settling in, and he has plenty of time for friends and family... until an announcement from Sylphie and an unexpected letter upend his idyllic school life.
episodes.title: Turning Point 3

episodes.overview: With Nanahoshi's help, Rudeus gains a way to shorten his journey, but he and Elinalise will still need to hurry if they hope to return before Sylphie gives birth. Their first obstacle: the harsh desert of Begaritt and its monstrous denizens.
episodes.title: Desert Journey

episodes.overview: Rudeus and Elinalise reach Rapan and soon reunite with Paul, only to learn that a deadly labyrinth has claimed both Zenith and Roxy. The fruits of Rudeus's studies offer a last, faint hope to reach his mother and his mentor in time.
episodes.title: Into the Labyrinth

episodes.overview: With Roxy's rescue, the search for Zenith resumes in earnest. Rudeus reconnects with his mentor amid the perils of the labyrinth. But why does she seem a little more awkward around him than before?
episodes.title: Magic Circle to the Sixth Stratum

episodes.overview: The rescue party reaches the heart of the Teleporter Labyrinth and confronts its guardian. But when the monster shrugs off Rudeus's magic, they realize they may have bitten off more than they can chew.
episodes.title: Parents

episodes.overview: Roxy makes a desperate move to pull Rudeus out of his depression. As the group journeys home, both of them must face their feelings and negotiate the consequences.
episodes.title: Let's Go Home

episodes.overview: Rudeus arrives home, frantic that something may have gone wrong in his absence. But the conversations waiting for him may become disasters in their own right. How can he introduce a new wife to a family still reeling from Paul's death?
episodes.title: Succession

episodes.overview: Ghislaine takes Eris to train under the Sword God, but Eris's brash attitude angers the other disciples.
episodes.title: Burn Bright, Mad Dog

episodes.overview: Nina continues to eye Eris as a rival, but training with masters of other styles sparks new discoveries.
episodes.title: Howl, Mad Dog

episodes.overview: Rudeus starts a new life with Roxy and Sylphiette, but not all his friends approve of his second marriage.
episodes.title: Life Back at Home

episodes.overview: Fearful of losing more loved ones, Rudeus begs Roxy to teach him a more potent form of magic.
episodes.title: A King-Class Water Mage

episodes.overview: Rudeus attends Cliff and Elinalise's wedding and goes shopping for his sisters' birthday presents.
episodes.title: Celebrations

episodes.overview: Rudeus accompanies Roxy on a bodyguard mission and runs into an unexpected face from his past.
episodes.title: Another Domestic Disaster?

episodes.overview: Following a successful summoning experiment, Nanahoshi offers Rudeus a reward.
episodes.title: Phase Four

episodes.overview: Rudeus seeks an audience with the hero Perugius, hoping to find a cure for his mother's condition.
episodes.title: The Flying Fortress

episodes.overview: Nanahoshi contracts an ancient disease. Seeing her lose hope, Rudeus races to find help.
episodes.title: Lament

episodes.overview: Rudeus and friends locate Kishirika, only to be captured along with her by the guards of a warlike Demon King.
episodes.title: An Audience with an Immortal Demon King

episodes.overview: Rudeus receives a puzzling message in his dreams. But before he can act on it, a strange visitor appears.
episodes.title: Turning Point 4

episodes.overview: Rudeus's strange guest recounts his future and reveals the cause of all his misfortunes.
episodes.title: An End and a Beginning

episodes.overview: In a future that could have been, Rudeus crumbles under the weight of loss.
episodes.title: The Diary

episodes.overview: Having read one possible future, Rudeus takes action to avoid it and protect the people he loves.
episodes.title: Resolve
